receptionist_intro: ^Welcome! You're just in time—it's not too late for you to get out of here.
^Not every door opens with a key. For some, you will have to rely purely on your logic. Pay close attention to the details.
^There are old photographs hanging on the walls. Decipher them to find the correct room number!
receptionist_questions: ^Can you just give me the exact formula?
^Got it, I'll examine the pictures now.

c-0: ^Look closely at what is depicted in them. Nothing is there by accident. Every single picture holds a hidden value if you look hard enough.
c-1: ^Read the pictures from left to right. Add them together, then divide.
c-2: ^I'm afraid not. If I say too much, it puts us both in danger. You have to figure out the calculation on your own.
c-3: ^Keep your eyes open and trust your logic.

told_everything: ^Leave me alone! I already told you everything I know.
^We shouldn't be seen talking. Just focus on the photographs on the wall and find that room number!
